title: A letter, dark

text: Aa Sunday, August 30, 2026 So it rained all morning so we sat by the window and you tried to catch the drops on the glass. You were so serious about it. From Mama Hear Mama 0:42 Spoken, with small fixes. Recording kept on this phone. Exactly as said Make private Delete
